messages.author: ebc70be8aef7a685
messages.subject: gdistsamp: problems with parboot
parts:
Hello,

I'm trying to run a set of HDS models using gdistsamp but I'm having problems using the parboot funtion. 

My best model is:
Dry1$PW2E2._NB

Call:
gdistsamp(lambdaformula = ~Pweb_psi + I(Pweb_psi^2) + Elev + 
    I(Elev^2), phiformula = ~rep - 1, pformula = ~Time, data = umfDry1, 
    output = "abund", unitsOut = "ha", mixture = "NB", 
    K = 200)

Abundance:
              Estimate     SE     z   P(>|z|)
(Intercept)     4.0588 0.1489 27.26 1.27e-163
Pweb_psi        0.5127 0.1663  3.08  2.05e-03
I(Pweb_psi^2)  -0.0815 0.0787 -1.04  3.00e-01
Elev            0.5257 0.1301  4.04  5.32e-05
I(Elev^2)      -0.6179 0.1148 -5.38  7.32e-08

Availability:
     Estimate      SE      z P(>|z|)
rep1    0.427   0.411 1.0391   0.299
rep2    9.483  65.129 0.1456   0.884
rep3   12.911 269.900 0.0478   0.962

Detection:
            Estimate     SE      z P(>|z|)
(Intercept)   2.9426 0.0203 144.95   0.000
Time         -0.0134 0.0132  -1.01   0.312

Dispersion:
 Estimate   SE    z P(>|z|)
    0.761 0.24 3.17 0.00153

AIC: 1232.018 

and I'm using the fitstats function for the GoF analysis:

# Function returning three fit-statistics.
fitstats <- function(fm) {
  observed <- getY(fm@data)
  expected <- fitted(fm)
  resids <- residuals(fm)
  sse <- sum(resids^2)
  chisq <- sum((observed - expected)^2 / expected)
  freeTuke <- sum((sqrt(observed) - sqrt(expected))^2)
  out <- c(SSE=sse, Chisq=chisq, freemanTukey=freeTuke)
  return(out)
}

set.seed(1234)
pbDry1 <- parboot(Dry1$PW2E2._NB, fitstats, nsim=2, report=1) #using 2 just to see if works

But then I have this error:

pbDry1 <- parboot(Dry1$PW2E2._NB, fitstats, nsim=2, report=1)
Error in integrate(grhn, db[j], db[j + 1], sigma = sigma[i, t], rel.tol = 1e-04) : 
  non-finite function value
Called from: integrate(grhn, db[j], db[j + 1], sigma = sigma[i, t], rel.tol = 1e-04)
Browse[1]> 

and a new "integrate" windows saying [Debug location is aproximate because the source is not avaiable] opens.

I also try to use:

freeTuke <- function(fm) {
  observed <- getY(fm@data)
  expected <- fitted(fm)
  sum((sqrt(observed) - sqrt(expected))^2)
}

but I have the same problem.

I'm not sure how to resolve this or what exactly means. I'm relatively new in "unmaked" and I'm using the Kery and Royle book but If anyone can help me with this I'll be extremely grateful.

Thank you very much in advance!

Best,
Steven

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: gdistsamp: problems with parboot
parts:
Hi Steven,

Your availability estimates for years 2 and 3 appear to have gigantic standard errors. I am guessing this uncertainty is causing issues when parboot is trying to new datasets. I would check to see if this is a consistent problem among your candidate models and if so, possibly try simplifying your models so that you get reasonable estimates for availability.

Ken
